bounded_conclusion: The three preregistered checks passed within their stated scope, but a post-audit reconciliation of final runner state with the command sampler found a shared wiring defect: all 32 jobs retained only the three initially-seen goals because the new online collectors never accumulated event.observed_goals into runner.seen_goals. Consequently delivery and most workshop goals could not enter the commanded-goal distribution. The all-zero gate is not interpretable as an algorithm capability result.
decision: Fix the common seen-goal accumulation in both online-value and SD-SAC collectors, rerun the unchanged 32-job fixed-normal development matrix in a new RAID run root, and keep the 72-job fixed/mutant main matrix closed. Do not launch the planned near-delivery PQN diagnostic because the upstream common defect was found first.

definitions.all_zero_gate: All 32 development jobs scored 0/32 fixed-kernel natural-reset delivery successes and 0/32 common-setup delivery successes under deterministic greedy evaluation.
definitions.diagnostic_complete: The three authorized checks completed; this does not mean normal delivery was learned.
definitions.goal_done_without_world_done: The commanded delivery predicate became true while the underlying world episode had not reached its reset condition.
definitions.valid_transition: A collector transition whose command was active and therefore entered the learner mask.

existing_success_policy_evaluator_bridge.policy: Dual PPO fixed adaptation checkpoint at update 4096, seed 20
existing_success_policy_evaluator_bridge.scope_limit: This establishes that the shared frozen evaluator and observation adapter can preserve a known successful PPO policy. It does not validate every algorithm-specific action policy or independently validate environment semantics.

next_bounded_diagnostic.replacement: unchanged 32-job fixed-normal development rerun after the shared fix
next_bounded_diagnostic.requirement_before_launch: Freeze the exact candidate, environment, seeds, update budget, evaluation episodes, checkpoint destination, comparison metric, and stopping rule in a separate manifest.
next_bounded_diagnostic.shape: One preregistered PQN candidate in one environment, comparing a delivery-near reset distribution with the original natural reset distribution.

correction: carry event.observed_goals through the online transition/SD-SAC rollout
OR-reduce time and worker axes into runner.seen_goals after each rollout
persist per-goal commanded, successful, and seen counts in update logs
post_audit_shared_wiring_defect.evidence_scope: all 32 final development checkpoints plus source comparison with the established PPO collectors
post_audit_shared_wiring_defect.interpretation_boundary: This establishes a common command-distribution defect. It does not predict whether any corrected method will learn normal delivery.
post_audit_shared_wiring_defect.reward_alignment: The only rewarded goals retained in final SD-SAC replay windows were members of the same three-goal initial set; delivery rewards were absent.

source_localization.downstream_effect: sample_false_seen_goal draws only from runner.seen_goals, so delivery could never be selected as a command goal in the affected runs.
established_collectors: src/hackrl/tick_claim_gc.py accumulates event.observed_goals after every rollout
src/hackrl/pack_restore_gc.py accumulates event.observed_goals after every rollout

provenance.checkpoint_mutation_check: All source checkpoints were opened read-only; the diagnostic wrote only its result JSON.

purpose: Complete a bounded no-training localization of the all-zero fixed-normal delivery gate before any main online-algorithm matrix is opened.

scripted_success_trace_collector_and_tar.scope_limit: This checks the fixed legal success trace and synthetic one-step targets, including the terminal transition. It does not exhaust all unsuccessful, truncated, replay-sampled, or nonterminal trajectories.

missing_historical_metrics.interpretation: Missing historical fields are unobserved, not zero. PQN, LEO, and Dual retained no replay. SD-SAC retained only its final replay window.

stored_learning_signal_and_optimizer_aud.optimizer_scope_limit: Exact counters plus changed parameter hashes establish that optimizer applications occurred. They do not establish that every gradient used the intended objective or experience.

sd_sac_final_replay_windows.interpretation: Some non-delivery goal success experience is present in every retained SD-SAC window. This does not prove that the final greedy policy learned those goals. No retained window contains a delivery reward, but earlier SD-SAC delivery experience is unobserved rather than proven absent.
